Thanks for flagging this — the vulnerability reporting channel you're asking for is already in place.

- **SECURITY.md** at the repo root documents how to report: via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/security/advisories/new) or email at **security@nousresearch.com**. See `SECURITY.md` Section 1 for required submission details.
- The GitHub Security Advisory feature is already enabled and actively used — multiple researchers have filed reports through it successfully.

If you have a vulnerability to report, please use one of those channels rather than a public issue. Closing as the requested feature is already implemented.

*This is an automated [hermes-sweeper](https://github.com/teknium1/hermes-sweeper) review.*
